_note: seamWeldTolMm stitches the printed seams so a zone grows until maxAngleDeg stops it rather
than until the part runs out. 0.6 clears the chair's widest real contact gap (0.530mm,
seat-center to seat-back-bottom) and still leaves out the central rear brace in the CAD
assembly (x -90..90, y 92..186, z -663..-455): it sits 1.008mm from anything else, and the
app has no part for it, so a zone must never grow onto it.
The angles below are the measured knee of coverage against stretch, not round numbers —
'back' at 55deg wraps around the U onto both handles' inner faces and unwraps at 20x, at
35deg it is 962cm2 across 6 parts at 1.13x. Re-check the bake log after changing any of them.
The wing seeds must sit ON the fender's forward face: the face's area centroid hangs in air
inside the arch and seeds a 14-triangle sheet hidden in it. At 40deg each wing zone is
100cm2 at 1.016x and shares no triangle with 'left'/'right'; at 50deg it reaches 128cm2 but
claims 2 triangles 'left'/'right' already own, cutting the same artwork twice at the join.
